title: Nearly Quadratic Additive Gaps for Edge-Clique Partitions of Split Graphs
abstract: For all sufficiently large n there is an n-vertex split graph that stays connected after removing any set of fewer than ceiling(n/5) vertices. Its exact edge-clique partition number exceeds the fractional optimum by at least a positive constant times n^2 (log n)^(-5/2) times exp(-2 sqrt(log(24/7) log n)). The same lower bound holds with the fractional optimum restricted to cliques of order at most four. The construction combines a local triangle-packing obstruction, a signed weight estimate on affine blocks, and host assignments in a split graph.
